title: Kosinj Bridge
scope: Lika River masonry bridge with three clear stone vaults, two round through-oculi, dressed voussoirs, low rounded pier plinths, plain coping and a narrow paved deck.
heightPolicy: The model uses a 482 m datum. The nearly level paved deck rises from 490.04 m to 490.98 m. The mapped terrain and native river set the placement context.
limitations: The retained outline and attributed route establish the signed axis and bank contacts. Vault proportions, oculi and coping follow ordinary side photographs.
The deck grade and approach support fit the standard terrain. The south approach terrain is lower than the deck in the source DEM.
